issues.description: The problem statement asks students to implement a function named `print_newline`, but the reference solution defines a function labeled `print_nl`. The template also does not provide a `print_newline` stub. This identifier mismatch (and missing stub) can confuse students about the expected symbol name and may lead to mismatches between student code and the reference solution or any automated checks.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across artifacts. Rename the solution label `print_nl:` to `print_newline:` (and export it if necessary), or alternatively update the problem statement to request `print_nl`. Additionally, consider adding a `print_newline` stub in the template (e.g. `print_newline: \n    ret`) so students have a clear place to implement the function.
